description: Adders, subtractors, multiplexers, demultiplexers, encoders, decoders and comparators.

questions.questionText: What is a combinational circuit?
questions.optionA: A circuit whose output depends only on present inputs
questions.optionB: A circuit whose output always depends on previous state
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A circuit whose output depends only on present inputs. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a half adder?
questions.optionB: A circuit that adds two one-bit binary numbers
questions.optionC: A circuit that subtracts four bits
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A circuit that adds two one-bit binary numbers. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What are the outputs of a half adder?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Sum and Carry. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What gate is commonly used to generate the Sum of a half adder?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is XOR. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What gate generates the Carry of a half adder?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is AND. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a full adder?
questions.optionB: A circuit that adds three one-bit inputs including carry-in
questions.optionC: A circuit that adds only two bits
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A circuit that adds three one-bit inputs including carry-in. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What are the inputs of a full adder?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A, B and Carry-in. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What are the outputs of a full adder?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Sum and Carry-out. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a half subtractor?
questions.optionA: A circuit that subtracts one bit from another
questions.optionB: A circuit that adds two bytes
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A circuit that subtracts one bit from another. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What are the outputs of a half subtractor?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Difference and Borrow. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a multiplexer?
questions.optionC: A circuit that selects one of several inputs and sends it to one output
questions.optionD: A circuit that sends one input to many outputs
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A circuit that selects one of several inputs and sends it to one output. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is another name for a multiplexer?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Data selector. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a demultiplexer?
questions.optionA: A circuit that routes one input to one of several outputs
questions.optionB: A circuit that selects many inputs
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A circuit that routes one input to one of several outputs. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a decoder?
questions.optionB: A circuit that converts coded inputs into a set of output lines
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A circuit that converts coded inputs into a set of output lines. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is an encoder?
questions.optionC: A circuit that converts one active input among many into a coded output
questions.optionD: A circuit that converts binary to decimal display only
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A circuit that converts one active input among many into a coded output. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: How many output lines does a 2-to-4 decoder normally have?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is 4. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: How many select lines are required for a 4-to-1 multiplexer?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is 2. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: How many select lines are required for an 8-to-1 multiplexer?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is 3. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a comparator used for?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Comparing binary numbers. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What does a 1-bit comparator compare?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Two one-bit values. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a parity generator used for?
questions.optionA: Generating a parity bit for error detection
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Generating a parity bit for error detection. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a parity checker used for?
questions.optionB: Checking parity for possible transmission errors
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Checking parity for possible transmission errors. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a priority encoder?
questions.optionC: An encoder that gives priority when multiple inputs are active
questions.explanation: Correct answer is An encoder that gives priority when multiple inputs are active. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a code converter?
questions.optionD: A combinational circuit that converts data from one code to another
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A combinational circuit that converts data from one code to another. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.

questions.questionText: What is a BCD-to-seven-segment decoder used for?
questions.optionA: Driving a seven-segment display from BCD input
questions.explanation: Correct answer is Driving a seven-segment display from BCD input. This is a fundamental Digital Electronics concept.
